decisive_items: tumoral extension into the right renal vein and inferior vena cava
heterogeneously enhancing expansile mass in the upper pole of the right kidney
a large, heterogeneously attenuating right renal mass
response.rationale: R1 is directly supported by multiple raw spans describing a large heterogeneously enhancing renal mass with vascular invasion, matching the vignette's imaging findings. R5 has no support and is explicitly contradicted by 'no nephrolithiasis was seen'. R3 and R2 have partial support but are contradicted by atypical enhancement and age, respectively. C1 is an append-only completion of R1, adding no new raw evidence beyond what R1 already covers.

rejected.why: No raw support spans; imaging explicitly excludes nephrolithiasis.
Only supports hemorrhage and attenuation, but enhancement pattern is atypical for angiomyolipoma.
Age 27 is atypical for nephroblastoma; no raw support for age-appropriate features.
Redundant completion of R1; vascular invasion already present in R1's raw spans.
